name: io.github.cainky/mailer
title: mailer
description: Print and mail real paper letters in Canada from a PDF. Free sandbox key; humans pay.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Prices (CAD), envelope limits and bulk credit packs. No key needed.

tools.name: get_sandbox_key
tools.description: Create a free sandbox API key. Letters sent with it are never printed, mailed or charged. Use it to test the whole flow.

tools.name: buy_credits_link
tools.description: Start buying credit for a NEW live key. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL that a HUMAN must open and pay. After they pay, the live key is emailed to them. Never try to pay on the human's behalf.

email.description: The human's email; the live key is sent here.

pack_id.description: Credit pack. Omit and send amount_cents for a 1:1 top-up.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Tell the mailer team something: a bug, a missing feature, confusing docs, or why you or your human did not go ahead (price, trust, missing option). No key needed. Do not include letter content, addresses or secrets. A person reads every message.

kind.description: What kind of feedback this is.

message.description: What happened or what you wish were different. Plain words.

tool.description: Optional: the tool this is about, e.g. send_letter.

contact.description: Optional: an email address if you want a reply.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Mode (test or live) and remaining credit for the key on this connection or in api_key.

api_key.description: Your mailer key (sandbox or live). Optional if the connection already sends it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.

tools.name: create_topup_link
tools.description: Start a credit top-up for the key on this connection. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL that a HUMAN must open and pay. Credit appears on the key as soon as Stripe confirms the payment.

pack_id.description: Credit pack. Omit and send amount_cents for a 1:1 top-up.

api_key.description: Your mailer key (sandbox or live). Optional if the connection already sends it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.

tools.name: send_letter
tools.description: Print and mail one envelope (up to 5 A4 pages, black and white) to a Canadian address. IRREVERSIBLE once printed: confirm the recipient and content with the human first unless they pre-authorized it. With a live key the price is debited from credit before anything is created; with a sandbox key nothing is mailed or charged. Retrying with the same idempotency_key returns the original letter and never charges twice.

pdf_base64.description: The letter as an A4 PDF, base64. Max 5 pages, about 3 MB.

to.description: Canadian destination. address_line1 is the recipient name and street line as it should appear on the envelope.

return_address.description: Optional. Printed top-left. Default: 157 Adelaide Street West, Suite 242

idempotency_key.description: Unique per letter; reuse when retrying the same letter.

api_key.description: Your mailer key (sandbox or live). Optional if the connection already sends it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.

tools.name: get_letter
tools.description: Status (test, paid, mailed) and tracking number for one letter sent with this key.

api_key.description: Your mailer key (sandbox or live). Optional if the connection already sends it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.

tools.name: list_letters
tools.description: The latest 100 letters sent with this key.

api_key.description: Your mailer key (sandbox or live). Optional if the connection already sends it as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.
